name: Typed text, zoom to footage
what: Three lines are typed on a speckled page (the middle one in a highlight box that grows with the letters); the page zooms out and rushes away in a zoom blur, and a footage frame rushes in and settles with a line typed above it and a big word typed below.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f58 three lines typed letter by letter (a highlight box grows with the middle and last lines); f59-f69 the page zooms out, accelerating, with a growing zoom blur and the page tiling around it; f70 a hard cut to the footage frame, small and tiled; f71 it rushes in to 1.74 x; f72-f100 it settles back to 1 x (decelerating, the blur fading) while the line above (f71-f92) and the big word below (f72-f92) are typed; then a hold to the end

tracks.name: typed lines
tracks.what: three lines typed letter by letter, a highlight box growing with the letters of two of them

tracks.name: zoom out
tracks.what: the page shrinks to 0.62 x, the zoom blur grows and the page tiles around it

tracks.name: rush in
tracks.what: the footage frame, small and tiled at f70, jumps to 1.74 x in one frame

tracks.name: settle
tracks.what: the footage frame, the line above and the word below settle to 1 x, the blur fading

tracks.name: typed texts
tracks.what: the line above the frame and the big word below are typed
tracks.easing: none (a letter every 1.3 f, the big word every 4 f)
